query: Draft a user story to add two new tracked fields (Last Reassessment Date, Last Reassessed By) to the Ancillary Assessment object, with field-level security for the credentialing permission sets. Priority P1.
expected_behavior: Uses the concrete persona 'Ancillary Cred Specialist' (acting as data steward is acceptable), never 'user' or 'developer'
Field-creation acceptance criteria use Pattern B (structured bullets: API Name, Object, Type, Label, Track History, Required) and do NOT force a Given/When/Then shape
Permission-set / FLS acceptance criteria use Pattern C (Object-level and Field-level split per permission set)
Confirms the Ancillary Assessment object / field API names against the codebase (code-review-graph or describe) rather than inventing PRM_* names, and flags any that cannot be verified
Includes a '## Technical Implementation (high-level)' section, a Definition of done that covers deployment + FLS, and an Estimated Effort table
Does not include unrelated behavioural ACs when the story is purely metadata creation
